sections.means: Named generic makers, including Sun Pharma and Dr Reddy's, were in market within days of the 21 March launch, with prices from ₹1,300.
sections.todo: Track whether generic prices hold as the launch rush levels off.

sections.h2: Within a month, semaglutide's share of India's GLP-1 category rose from 25% to 33%

chart.title: Semaglutide gained category share in March as Eli Lilly's fell

sections.means: Eli Lilly's overall share fell from 61% to 56% in the first month after expiry, while Novo's own branded share held at 25%.
sections.todo: Watch the next monthly share data to see whether semaglutide's gain holds.
